title: Support Tickets and Mail
case_ids_frozen_by: P14 contract-freeze revision; Master Plan supplies requirements, not P14-Txxx identifiers

capability_contract.scope: Close P14 ticket/mail/request-linkage authority only. P06/P13 domain entitlement decisions remain independent; P09 owns mandatory ClamAV core; P12 owns Workspace membership and notification core; P15 auth lifecycle, P17 permission lifecycle/approval UI, and P19 final Website/SEO remain later-owned.

inherited_authorities.scope: Workspace membership/RBAC and notification core are inherited. P14 only produces support-category notifications through the P12 core.
Custom-domain request/approval/ownership/DNS/HTTPS/risk authority is inherited; AccessRequest may reference a support ticket but a ticket cannot create active entitlement.
Mandatory ClamAV fail-closed scanning authority is inherited for ticket attachments; P14 must not create a weaker scanner bypass.

rules: Only the three listed IA exact APIs are described as IA-exact; remaining P14 API routes are P14 implementation authority.
Request access uses /app/support/new?category=custom-domain-access and POST /api/support/tickets only; no direct entitlement grant route is introduced by P14.
No invented /app/tickets or /app/mail aliases; Workspace Support and Admin Tickets/Mail use the canonical IA routes.
Admin tickets.mail surfaces consume tickets.manage/mail.manage but P14 does not implement P17 permission lifecycle.
WEB-CONTACT functionality belongs to P14, while final Website composition/canonical/hreflang/technical SEO remains P19-owned.
Workspace/Admin private surfaces are authenticated, noindex and no-store; UI guards never replace server authorization.
Ticket IDs are opaque, non-sequential externally and always re-authorized by current requester/workspace/admin scope.
Workspace tickets persist workspace_id and requester_user_id; public contact persists a separate public-contact requester record rather than inventing Workspace membership.
Internal notes are admin-only and are never returned through requester APIs or mail templates.
Ticket create/reply/close is idempotent where a client idempotency key is supplied and cannot duplicate messages or outbound mail.
Cross-workspace/foreign ticket IDs fail closed without existence disclosure.
Closing a ticket affects ticket state only; it does not settle payment, modify plan, grant entitlement or mutate a custom domain.

domain_request_contract.projection: Eligible request may project to P06 AccessRequest{workspace_id,support_ticket_id} and resolves requested/source=none only when no independent active entitlement exists.
rules: Ticket create/reply/close never calls a manual-approval or plan-grant mutation.
A support ticket ID may be referenced by an independent P17/P06 approval record later; the existence of the ticket is not approval.
If P13 plan authority already grants an active domain entitlement, the ticket does not override or duplicate it.
Request linkage is immutable/correlated and audit-visible.
Attachment bytes enter quarantine before any requester/admin download path becomes available.
Only clean state may be attached/downloaded; infected, timeout, scanner unavailable, stale or indeterminate results fail closed.
P14 reuses the inherited P09 ClamAV boundary; no alternate permissive scanner path is allowed.
Filename/MIME/size policy is server-side and response-safe; paths, storage keys and scanner evidence are not exposed.
Attachment evidence records hashes/size/state/correlation only and excludes file content and unnecessary PII.
Turnstile token is verified server-side before durable contact/ticket creation for the protected submission path.
Missing/invalid/expired/replayed token fails closed and produces no ticket/contact/mail/entitlement mutation.
Raw Turnstile token/secret/provider response is never logged or persisted in ordinary evidence.
CI uses a deterministic server-side verifier adapter; production test bypass is prohibited.
Provider verification failure maps to a safe Turnstile error and does not silently bypass rate limits.
Mail jobs are durable and correlate to one allowlisted template key/version, recipient purpose and resource identity.
Template variables are key-specific allowlists; unknown/missing unsafe variables fail before enqueue/send.
Subject/body rendering redacts secrets/tokens/provider evidence and never renders internal notes unless a dedicated internal-only template explicitly owns them.
Claim/send completion is idempotent; concurrent workers cannot send one logical job twice.
Transient delivery failures use bounded backoff/retry; terminal failure is durable/auditable and can be inspected safely.
CI proves real SMTP protocol delivery against a deterministic local sink; no live production SMTP credential or external delivery is required.
Mail delivery success is notification/communication evidence only and never authorization, entitlement or payment settlement authority.

notification_contract.owner: P14 producer events only; P12 owns notification core.
rules: Producer is internal-only and uses P12 recipient+dedupe_key idempotency.
Deep links are /app/support or /app/support/{ticketId} and are reauthorized by P12 core at read time.
Title/summary/context exclude email addresses, attachment names when sensitive, Turnstile data, SMTP credentials and internal notes.
P14 does not add a public arbitrary notification emit endpoint.
Raw idempotency material, Turnstile tokens, SMTP secrets/passwords and attachment bytes are not stored in audit/evidence metadata.
Mutable ticket/admin-mail settings use optimistic concurrency/versioning where applicable.
Public-contact email is PII: necessary DB use is allowed, but ordinary logs/evidence are redacted and browser/admin exposure is least-privilege.
Mail template/job/audit metadata is allowlisted and secret-safe.

workspace: ticket requester/current Workspace member: list own/Workspace-visible tickets according to P12 membership and reply when ticket is open
foreign Workspace member: no existence disclosure or read/reply mutation
admin: tickets.manage: Admin ticket list/detail/reply/state/internal-note authority; P14 consumes permission only
mail.manage: Admin mail queue/template/settings/test authority; P14 consumes permission only
rules: Every Workspace ticket request re-resolves current P12 membership and requester ownership server-side.
Public contact never gains Workspace membership or authenticated Support access from email alone.
Client/test role headers are never production ticket/admin authorization authority.
P17 remains owner of administrator/role/permission lifecycle.
Canonical desktop/tablet/mobile plus 320 CSS px reflow, keyboard/focus/name-role-value and reduced-motion evidence where applicable.
Persistent ticket/mail/attachment failure is visible in-page and is not toast-only or color-only.
Offline/partial failures retain safe prior context but never present a send/reply/scan as successful without server confirmation.
Workspace/Admin Support/Mail pages are noindex/no-store; WEB-CONTACT P14 proves functional states but P19 retains final Website/SEO authority.
Direct URL loads repeat authentication/tenant/permission checks; navigation visibility is not authorization.

environment_contract.redis: Real Redis for P14 rate/idempotency/worker coordination where used; durable authority remains server-side.
environment_contract.smtp: Real local SMTP protocol sink in CI; no live production credentials or external recipient required.
environment_contract.clamav: Real inherited P09 ClamAV boundary for attachment scan evidence; unavailable/timeout/indeterminate fail closed.
environment_contract.turnstile: Deterministic server-side verifier adapter in CI; production bypass prohibited.
environment_contract.p12: Reuse P12 Workspace membership and notification core.
environment_contract.p06_p13: Reuse independent domain entitlement/request and billing/plan authorities; ticket mutation is never grant authority.
environment_contract.browser: Built Website/Workspace/Admin surfaces with real local APIs.

closure.predecessor_rule: Bind P13 signed source 24cdbdf848bf722e53e38ed15dce12e1d42eb9d2 / integration a94f1d9894916b995a2379571f6ab3de520fc4ba / run 32711262325 / artifact 9514396804 / digest sha256:494a7942272afac7588eab153c07daf5a1f557c10b58b0dbd915eeda8709e998; do not rerun/reinterpret P13 revision-specific closure on P14 HEAD. P12 notification/workspace, P06 domain entitlement/request and P09 ClamAV signed authorities are inherited functionally.
closure.scope_rule: P14 closes Support Tickets/Mail/request linkage only; P06/P13 entitlement decisions, P09 ClamAV core, P12 notification core, P15 identity lifecycle, P17 permission/approval lifecycle and P19 Website/SEO remain separately owned.
